card.name: Measurement units right after a number
card.fires_on: Unit words such as km, kg, mg, mL and /min that come straight after a number, mostly in tables and dosing formulas. It also fires on a few other short endings like .org.

modes.label: Units after numbers
modes.description: A unit of length, weight, dose or rate follows a numeral in a table or formula.

modes.label: Rate part of a unit
modes.description: The second half of a compound unit such as mL/min comes after the slash.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write measurement units such as mm, Hz, km, mph and hours.
card.plain: It spots a number that is waiting for its unit, like km, kg or mg.
